title: caltha palustris subsp. asarifolia
intro: Caltha palustris subsp. asarifolia, commonly known as Marsh Marigold, is a plant species native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, providing relief for various health conditions. The health benefits of Marsh Marigold include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, wounds, and digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of Marsh Marigold include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-tumor, anti-histamine, and anti-spasmodic effects.
